note: Honda's i-CTDi / i-DTEC diesels (N22A, 20T2N, N16A1) were partly recorded as petrol. Honda specifies a thin oil for its modern i-VTEC petrols (0W-20) and a low-SAPS grade for the diesels, whose particulate filter makes it a requirement. The older D, B, F, A and E series take a conventional grade suited to hot climates. Capacities are family figures unless stated otherwise.

engines.source: i-CTDi / i-DTEC 1.6 and 2.2 (N22A1, N22A2, N16A1, 20T2N) — Accord, CR-V, Civic, FR-V. Particulate filter fitted, so the low-SAPS grade is a requirement. Part of the range was recorded as petrol.
Modern i-VTEC and VTEC Turbo (L13, L15, R18, R20, K20C) — Jazz, Civic, CR-V, HR-V. Honda specifies 0W-20 for these; a heavier grade is withheld deliberately.
K-series 2.0/2.4 i-VTEC and J-series V6 — Accord, CR-V, Civic Type R, Legend, Odyssey.
F-series and H-series 1.8-2.3 (F18B, F20A/B/Z, F22B, F23A, H22A, H23A) — Accord, Prelude, Shuttle.
B-series 1.6-2.0 VTEC (B16A2, B18C, B20B) — Civic, Integra, CR-V.
D-series 1.3-1.7 (D13B, D14A, D15B, D16Y, D17A) — Civic, CRX, HR-V, Logo. Very common older Honda.
A-series and the older E-series (A16A1, A20A, EV2, EW2/3, EL, EK) — Accord, Prelude, Civic, Concerto. Pre-1998 designs; 10W-40 suits hot climates.
